title: Lattice batcher: workload heuristic profiling, continuous parameter titration, guarded apply
creator: Ava Morozov
description: Problem: Hosts with mixed workloads have highly variable per-token costs due to suboptimal batching and cache cruft. We need an automated recommender that profiles workloads across time, suggests batching and prefix/KV cache configs, and applies them safely with rollback on regression. Lattice batcher will synthesize lightweight signatures of traffic, map to cost/latency frontier, then titrate micro-parameters continuously.
context: This ticket focuses on the recommendation engine and the guarded apply path. It complements runtime autotune components but sits in the Control Plane. Previous work exists on profiling (ENG-33120) and batch-config-synthesis (ENG-270415).
proposal: 1) Build a streaming profiler that emits compact signatures per tenant: sequence_length_histogram, mean_live_kv_window, request_cohort_id, p95-latency, tokens-per-request. 2) Train a cost-latency model offline via Monte Carlo sampling of batching parameters (max_batch_ms, batch_size_target, kv_window_ms). 3) Implement heuristics: KV-aware coalescing (avoid merging requests with incompatible KV prefixes), tail-latency guard (reduce batch delay when p99 > threshold), and burst-holdback (recover gradually after spikes). 4) Continuous titration: shadow-apply candidate configs to ~1% of traffic, measure delta on cost/unit and latency, then ramp via Bayesian bandit with safety gates. 5) Guarded apply: preflight checks, canary traffic, automated rollback on QoS regressions, manual override.
acceptance_criteria: Profiler produces per-tenant signatures updated every 15m
Offline cost-latency model can predict cost within 8% MAE for historical workloads
Shadow-apply pipeline captures delta metrics and stores traces
Guarded apply path successfully rolls forward candidate config to 10% traffic automatically, and rolls back within 5 minutes if p99 latency increases by >20% or error rate >0.5%
E2E test coverage for safety gates and rollback path
telemetry_and_metrics: Key metrics: cost_per_token (USD), p50/p95/p99 latency (ms), error_rate, tail_latency_slo_breach_count, kv_cache_hit_ratio, average_batch_size, batching_delay_ms. Telemetry stored in TSDB; sampler tags: tenant_id, region, model_family, time_of_day. Baseline dashboards: per-tenant cost vs rollout percentage.
rollout_and_safety_plan: Phase 0: internal simulation with replay of last 30 days of traffic (shadow only). Phase 1: 1% canary shadow with no apply. Phase 2: guarded apply to 10% with automated rollback rules. Phase 3: progressive roll to 50% with manual ops approval. Safety gates: anomaly detector on live telemetry, circuit breaker that freezes apply if traceback anomalies appear, mandatory manual hold for high-risk customers (tagged).
implementation_tasks: instrument profiler worker and signature exporter (Go)
guarded-apply controller with rollback rules (control-plane service)
CI tests and chaos test harness for rollback
console UI mockups for review & manual overrides
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: KV signature collisions could misgroup incompatible requests => Mitigation: conservative prefix hashing and collision detection, include sample request hashes
Risk: Model drift causes bad recommendations => Mitigation: daily retrain, conservatively biased decision threshold, canary shadowing
Risk: Telemetry noise causes spurious rollback => Mitigation: require sustained breach over 3 consecutive windows before rollback; use median+MAD smoothing
Risk: Customer impact during apply => Mitigation: per-tenant opt-out and manual approval for enterprise tenants
outstanding_questions: Optimal shadow-traffic sample size vs detection latency?
What SLA thresholds should trigger auto-rollback for different customer tiers?
How to version and surface config diffs in Console?
Do we need encryption or extra RBAC for profiler outputs? (security review?)
